full_prompt_en: A square stylized architectural illustration shows a compact building assembled from turquoise walls, terracotta arches, a dome, and an exterior stair. The scene sits on a flat pale stone plaza under a saturated teal sky. Puffy cream clouds gather at the left, while the distant horizon is largely hidden behind the building and low orange boundary walls. The main structure occupies the center and nearly fills the frame. On the left, a low block contains a tall rounded orange arch with a smaller dark doorway nested inside it. At the center, a higher rectangular wall rises into a narrow open arch, its interior painted rusty orange. In front of this wall, a broad curved arch frames a dark blue recess. On the right, an orange cylindrical volume with small inset windows supports a rounded dome that glows warm peach above a turquoise parapet. A straight open stair begins at the lower right and climbs diagonally toward the central arch, each tread lit along its front edge and shadowed beneath. Short low platforms step outward along the bottom, echoing the warm orange accent. Smooth wall faces show slight plaster grain and uneven weathering, preventing the colors from becoming perfectly flat. Strong sun from the upper left illuminates the turquoise front planes and orange edges, casting sharp blue-green shadows into the deep openings and to the right of the steps. The palette uses only a few bold hues, allowing arches, blocks, and circles to form an immediately readable abstract arrangement. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition is playful and sculptural, with simple volumes, rhythmic voids, and a clear warm-cool contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风格化建筑插图呈现一座紧凑建筑，由青绿色墙面、陶土色拱门、圆顶与室外台阶拼合而成。场景坐落在平坦浅石色广场上，头顶是饱和青蓝天空。奶油色蓬松云朵聚在左侧，远方地平线大多被建筑和低矮橙色围墙遮住。主体占据中央，几乎填满画幅。左侧，一座低体块里有高圆拱，橙色外框中嵌着更小的深色门洞。中央，更高的矩形墙升成窄长开放拱，内部涂成锈橙色。这道墙前，一条宽阔弯拱框住深蓝凹处。右侧，带小凹窗的橙色圆柱体撑起一个温暖桃色发光圆顶，露在青绿色女儿墙上方。笔直露天阶梯从右下角开始，斜向中央拱门攀升，每级踏步前缘受光，下方留阴影。短矮平台沿下缘向外逐级伸出，重复暖橙色重音。平顺墙面留有轻微灰泥颗粒和不均匀风化，避免色彩变得完全平坦。强日光从左上照来，照亮青绿色正面和橙边，并在深门洞及阶梯右侧投下锐利蓝绿色阴影。配色只用少数大胆色相，使拱、方块与圆形构成立即可读的抽象排列。画中没有人或可读文字。整体构图俏皮且有雕塑感，以简单体积、有节奏的空洞和清楚冷暖对照为特色。
style_prompt_en: The geometric illustration combines large matte color blocks, tactile plaster grain, and sharply cut openings. Saturated turquoise and teal oppose warm terracotta, peach, and cream, creating a strong but controlled complementary rhythm. Simple rectangular masses, broad curves, and rounded caps are stacked into a sculptural hierarchy. Hard sunlight from one side creates crisp shadows inside recesses and along stepped edges, making depth immediately legible. Small worn patches and uneven pigment keep flat planes from feeling digitally sterile. A low eye-level view and broad clear sky give the forms breathing room. The overall effect is playful, monumental in miniature, and strongly graphic, with color and shadow carrying the structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅几何插图把大型哑光色块、可感灰泥颗粒和锐利切出的开口结合。饱和绿松石色与青蓝对照暖陶土、桃色和奶油色，形成强烈却受控的互补节奏。简单矩形体块、宽阔曲线与圆润顶形叠成雕塑般的层级。一侧硬日光在凹处和阶梯边缘形成清晰阴影，使纵深立即可辨。小型磨旧斑和不均色料让平面不显数码无菌。低平视角与宽阔清澈天空给形体留出呼吸空间。整体效果俏皮、小尺度中仍显雄伟且图形力量强，由色彩与阴影承载结构。
theme_en: A turquoise and terracotta building of arches, stairs, and a dome
theme_zh: 由拱门、阶梯和圆顶组成的青绿与陶土色建筑
name: Michael Graves
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
